name: discord-patch-bot
description: Bot Discord pentru update-uri automate la jocuri

scripts.build: npm run build:rust && npm run build:ts
scripts.lint: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:strict
scripts.test:regression: npm run build && node --test dist/test/commands-regression.test.js dist/test/configValidator.test.js
scripts.precommit: npm run check && npm run audit
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:strict && npm run build && node dist/scripts/check-syntax.js && node dist/scripts/check-config.js && node --test dist/test
